items.title: What Is Goldman Sachs Group (GS) Doing With A $400 Million Cybersecurity Bet?
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) has agreed to invest US$400 million in cybersecurity firm Cyera in a fresh funding round. The Cyera deal increases Goldman Sachs' exposure to cybersecurity focused assets beyond its traditional investment banking activities. Management is using the Cyera stake to expand the group's presence in technology driven security infrastructure. Goldman Sachs' US$400 million Cyera investment lands alongside wider shifts in its cybersecurity focus that our research tracks...
